description: This PHP file defines the RelationshipFactory class, which provides a static method to create different types of relationship objects based on a given definition. It includes conditional logic to determine the specific class to instantiate for each relationship type, such as OneToOne, OneToMany, ManyToOne, and ManyToMany, and handles default cases. The class also references external relationship classes and a constants file used for relationship type identifiers.

classes.name: RelationshipFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating relationship instances based on a provided definition array. It centralizes the logic for instantiating different relationship types and handles default cases.

methods.name: newRelationship
methods.description: Creates and returns a new relationship object based on the specified relationship definition. If no relationship type is specified, defaults to ManyToMany. Handles special cases like 'for_activities' and routes to specific relationship classes based on type.

methods.name: newRelationship
methods.description: Creates a new relationship object based on the provided relationship definition array, defaulting to ManyToMany if no type is specified, and requiring external class files accordingly.
